blocks.items: 同下 臉前 種嗨兜 屋背戶 棟心 頂高 腳下 長凳 中意 係講 跌下來 大來

items.hak: 這隻係吾表弟阿傑，係吾舅仔嘅賴子。
items.zh: 這個是我表弟阿傑，是我小舅舅的兒子。
items.en: This is my cousin A-kiet, he is my younger uncle's son.

items.hak: 相片嘅背景好像在外國，係麼？
items.zh: 相片的背景好像在外國，是嗎？
items.en: The background of the photo seems to be in a foreign country, doesn't it?

items.hak: 係呀，佢摎其公其婆同下住在英國蘇格蘭。
items.zh: 是呀，他跟他爺爺奶奶一起住在英國蘇格蘭。
items.en: Yes, he lives in Scotland, UK with his grandparents.

items.hak: 其公其婆就係吾嘅姐公姐婆。
items.zh: 他爺爺奶奶就是我的外公外婆。
items.en: His grandparents are my maternal grandparents.

items.hak: 係呀，其間屋共總有六間房。
items.zh: 是呀，他的房子總共有六間臥室。
items.en: Yes, his house has six bedrooms in total.

items.hak: 屋臉前還有隻花園仔添。
items.zh: 房子前面還有個小花園。
items.en: There is also a small garden in front of the house.

items.hak: 其兜在這花園仔，種嗨兜繡球摎玫瑰花。
items.zh: 他們在這個小花園裏種了一些繡球花和玫瑰花。
items.en: They planted some hydrangeas and roses in this small garden.

items.hak: 其兜屋背戶應該有一隻大花園係麼？
items.zh: 他的房子後面應該有個大花園吧？
items.en: There should be a large garden behind his house, right?

items.hak: 係呀，屋背戶嘅花園好大，棟心有棵大蘋果樹。
items.zh: 是呀，房子後面的花園很大，中心有棵大蘋果樹。
items.en: Yes, the garden behind the house is very large, with a big apple tree in the center.
There are many apples on the tree.

items.hak: 坐在花園休息看書，真係好舒服喔。
items.zh: 坐在花園裏休息看書，真的好舒服呀。
items.en: It's really comfortable to sit in the garden and read.

items.hak: 蘋果樹腳下有一張長凳，阿傑好中意坐在唉裏看書嘅。
items.zh: 蘋果樹下面有一張長凳，阿傑很喜歡坐在那裏看書。
items.en: There is a bench under the apple tree, A-kiet likes to sit there and read.

items.hak: 係講有蘋果跌下來打中佢，佢大來就係隻科學家咯。
items.zh: 如果有蘋果掉下來打中他，他長大以後就是科學家了。
items.en: If an apple would fall down and hit him, he would grow up and become a scientist!

items.hak: 落大水，發大風，阿姨仔，嫁老公。
嫁去奈？嫁海豐。食乜介，食老蟹摎蝦公。

items.zh: 客家話有少部分字的聲母跟廣州話不同，要注意發音。
items.en: A small number of Hakka characters have different initial consonants compared to Cantonese. Pay attention to pronunciation.

items.zh: 「老」在{老虎}、{老蟹}、{老鼠}中唸**第四聲** `làu` ，比較特別。其他情況唸**第三聲** `lău`。
items.en: 老 is pronounced with the **fourth tone** `làu` in 'tiger' ({老虎}), 'crab' ({老蟹}), and 'rat' ({老鼠}), which is quite special. In other cases, it is pronounced with the **third tone** `lău`.

items.zh: 「發」在跟身體的病理或生理現象有關，或跟天氣現象有關時唸 `bŏt`。其他情況尤其是來自北方話的詞彙唸 `făt`。
items.en: 「發」 is pronounced `bŏt` when related to pathological/physiological phenomena or weather. In other cases, especially in vocabulary from Mandarin, it is pronounced `făt`.

items.zh: {兜}是「一些」的意思。例如{菜園種嗨兜青菜}
items.en: {兜} means 'some'. For example: {菜園種嗨兜青菜} (The vegetable garden has planted some vegetables).
